Quiet Drop.name: Quiet Drop
Quiet Drop.description: The user catches an unaware target from behind, covers their mouth and drops them with a choke or a strike to the back of the head. The target falls unconscious without a sound, and nobody nearby hears a thing. Works only on a target who has not noticed the user; an armored or hardened target, or a seasoned pro or villain, is only staggered and alerted. Stamina: brief.
